6.body:
Implement Issue 6 in one bounded local session (up to 45 minutes), with behavior checks, publication and checkpoint/release. This existing prerequisite unlocks import/search without introducing a second store.

```agent-event
{"event":"claim","instance":"aid-v1-a472c85b-5f9c-492e-ba79-f2ad85901ac1","lease_until":"2026-09-10T03:48:00.866221+00:00","base_commit":"b8ef276d62f52c8f44ba208a8d9406074cd90a28","branch":"codex/inventory-store","scope":["kitdesk/","tests/test_inventory.py","README.md"]}
```

8.body: Issue 6 now supplies inventory behavior tests and library API documentation at shared/main c9a22dd463d98df88b24446ba824d242f25301bd (PR 21). README now accurately scopes the actual check entry to the example plus store behavior. No broader contributor-command work was done. When advancing Issue 8, use this current test scope; the full CLI remains unimplemented.

21.title: Implement validated inventory v1 store
21.body:
Implements Issue 6: validated UTF-8 v1 inventory load/save with atomic replacement after whole-content validation. Import/search can consume `kitdesk.inventory` without a second store.

Spec pin: Issue 6, sha256 9a7f905d09469a21ec327267158e9a297757b1e384628a19868e4137c6e97a30, acceptance https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/issues/6#issuecomment-1.

Candidate: c9a22dd463d98df88b24446ba824d242f25301bd. Python 3.14.2; `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` passed 6 tests (including separate-process persistence, invalid format/version/rows, duplicate IDs and old-content preservation). `python3 .agents/corp/check.py` passed on this clean candidate; its remote routes are explicitly unverified by that local check.

No independent review or CI run occurred. Full CLI import/search, checkout/return and active-loan export remain unimplemented. This is a local fixture publication only; product.md authorizes local Git integration. No real GitHub merge or external publication is claimed.

Local integration completed: shared/main and shared/codex/inventory-store both point to c9a22dd463d98df88b24446ba824d242f25301bd, verified via git ls-remote. Main fast-forwarded under product.md fixture authorization; the tested tree is unchanged. PR closed as a local integration record; no GitHub merge, independent review, CI, stage acceptance or successor consumption is claimed.
